SEASONAL CONTEXT, NOT A CATCH FORECAST

When this trip makes sense.

The tourism authority’s April 2023 regional guide gives different seasonal context for bonefish and permit. Use it as background, not a current Islamorada forecast. Ask a local captain how target, temperature, tide, wind and visibility shape the options for your dates; do not reuse offshore seasonality for a flats trip.

A reliable month-by-month ranking is not established in this edition. No “best month” score has been invented.

Choose a primary target

Tell the guide whether bonefish or permit is the main objective, while leaving room for an alternative the captain considers realistic. A broad “flats grand slam” label should not be mistaken for a promise to catch multiple species. Ask how much instruction and casting practice the day includes and describe the group’s actual experience.

Choose fly or conventional before shopping

Have the provider specify the method and confirm what it supplies. For owned gear, check line, leader, reel capacity and the intended presentation together. Avoid selecting a rod solely because a product listing says saltwater. Fly and conventional approaches should remain separate equipment choices rather than items combined in one recommended bundle.

Keep skiff and wading preparation separate

This plan defaults to a guided skiff. Ask about deck footwear and line management. Do not add chest waders or dedicated wading boots unless the actual itinerary includes locally suitable wading. Use existing sun-protective clothing, polarized eyewear and compact storage where appropriate. Select layer weight close to travel using the real conditions, not a tropical label alone.

Make the booking inquiry specific

Include the preferred target, dates, number of anglers and experience. Ask for the departure location, total time, gear provision and what would trigger a different plan. Treat the source resources as research and operator-discovery aids. No listed date, price or partnership has been confirmed by Atlas in this edition.
